title: 40 — Native / Ugly Post-It Note Style (Product Hero)
description: A lifestyle product photo shot in a real-life setting (kitchen floor, bathroom counter, coffee table). Product centered but slightly off-axis — feels found, not composed. A yellow post-it note stuck directly onto the product face with tape, slightly crooked, with 3-4 lines of handwritten marker text (the hook / argument / punchline). No logo overlay, no designed text — the product packaging IS the brand, the post-it
